title: A Frankel type theorem in Euclidean and hyperbolic spaces
summary: We prove that a connected mean convex region in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ with at least two boundary components cannot have strictly positive mean curvature. This answers a question of Gromov. We also obtain estimates for how quickly the mean curvature must decay at infinity, and generalize this result to hyperbolic space.
